notes.title: [Patch Note] Fix on Wrapping Words and Font Engine Upgrade
notes.content:
Dear beloved PM Fans.
This is CFK support.
 
Again, we'd like to express the deep appreciation to all of you, PM 3 fans affections and patience.
 
With the latest patch, you would experience following enhancements.
 
*More explicit English font style implementation for PM 3
*Word wrapping text issue resolution
 
Meanwhile, your suggestions receiving from Forum and e-mails are well being collected right on end. CFK will do the best to reflect those opinions further. 
 
Best Regards
CFK

notes.title: Trading card update!
notes.content:
Dear Princess Maker Fans
Hope you all doing well

We,CFK do appreciate all the valuable inputs of yours and are trying those to be implemented. 

Today, we have an update news on Trading Cards, Badges, Wallpapers insertion as community items.
Let's collect all the eight Trading cards hand drawn by "Akai Takami", the original creator!!

Plus, enchanced embedded font engine will be coming over soon for more explicit text display along with 
Japanese and Chinese Language additions. 

Please be stay tuned with us.

Best Regards
CFK
